brief: Deliver a sales CSV with order_id, customer_email and revenue columns. Every order_id must be unique. Every customer_email must be present. Revenue must be a number greater than or equal to 0. Include at least 3 rows. The delivery must contain exactly the source order_id values. For each order_id, revenue must equal the source revenue.
